package.name: tars_recovery_behaviors
package.description: TARS custom Nav2 recovery behaviors. v1 ships MudAssess, a measurement-only drop-in replacement for the stock Wait behavior that records mudflat signals (probe angle availability, wheel motor currents, stall state) during recovery waits; record only: it never commands velocity and never changes the recovery outcome. v2 adds StallDetector, a BehaviorTree.CPP v3 ConditionNode that classifies FollowPath failures (stall-in-mud vs obstacle/unknown) so the recovery fallback trees can branch; fail-open: missing window data falls through to the default obstacle branch.
